record: Voted for H.R. 9340, the Ratepayer Protection Act, which requires data centers and other large electricity users to pay the full cost of new power; her release speaks of data centers and electricity bills and does not mention AI.
Issued a statement welcoming Meta's $50 billion expansion in Richland Parish, Louisiana, stressing that Meta would cover energy and water costs; the release does not mention AI.

Voted yes on House passage of H.R. 1 (One Big Beautiful Bill Act), whose House version contained a 10-year moratorium on state AI laws; this was a vote on the whole budget bill, not a stand-alone AI vote, and the Senate later removed the moratorium.
grade_reason: Her only quoted remark on AI found (October 2026) is about light-touch guardrails and beating China, with no acknowledgment of catastrophic risk. The same article reports, in the reporters' words only, that she doubted AI poses a true threat to humankind, which would be F if her own words were found, but no quote of that was found.
